@@CASE paging: small
mod=paging
opt Page size=1024
opt Addresses=100, 1500, 3000, 4095, 5000
--TEXT
0 5
1 2
2 7
3 0
--OK
Logical | Page | Offset | Frame | Physical  
--------+------+--------+-------+-----------
100     | 0    | 100    | 5     | 5220      
1500    | 1    | 476    | 2     | 2524      
3000    | 2    | 952    | 7     | 8120      
4095    | 3    | 1023   | 0     | 1023      
5000    | 4    | 904    | -     | PAGE FAULT

Formula: physical = frame * page_size + offset; page = address // page_size
@@END
@@CASE paging: edge
mod=paging
opt Page size=4
opt Addresses=0, 3, 4, 7, 8, 100
--TEXT
0 3
1 1
--OK
Logical | Page | Offset | Frame | Physical  
--------+------+--------+-------+-----------
0       | 0    | 0      | 3     | 12        
3       | 0    | 3      | 3     | 15        
4       | 1    | 0      | 1     | 4         
7       | 1    | 3      | 1     | 7         
8       | 2    | 0      | -     | PAGE FAULT
100     | 25   | 0      | -     | PAGE FAULT

Formula: physical = frame * page_size + offset; page = address // page_size
@@END
@@CASE paging: dup
mod=paging
opt Page size=4
opt Addresses=1
--TEXT
0 1
0 2
--ERR
Page 0 appears twice in the page table
@@END
@@CASE paging: badtoken
mod=paging
opt Page size=4
opt Addresses=abc
--TEXT
0 1
--ERR
Addresses: 'abc' is not a whole number
@@END
@@CASE paging: neg
mod=paging
opt Page size=0
opt Addresses=1
--TEXT
0 1
--ERR
Page size: 0 must be >= 1
@@END
@@CASE seg: small
mod=seg
opt Addresses=0:430, 1:10, 2:500, 3:400, 4:1222, 7:5
--TEXT
0 1400 1000
1 6300 400
2 4300 400
3 3200 1100
4 4700 1000
--OK
Address | Seg | Offset | Limit | Physical                 
--------+-----+--------+-------+--------------------------
0:430   | 0   | 430    | 1000  | 1830                     
1:10    | 1   | 10     | 400   | 6310                     
2:500   | 2   | 500    | 400   | TRAP: offset beyond limit
3:400   | 3   | 400    | 1100  | 3600                     
4:1222  | 4   | 1222   | 1000  | TRAP: offset beyond limit
7:5     | 7   | 5      | -     | TRAP: no such segment    

Rule: valid if offset < limit; physical = base + offset
@@END
@@CASE seg: edge
mod=seg
opt Addresses=0:0, 0:49, 0:50, 1:0
--TEXT
0 100 50
--OK
Address | Seg | Offset | Limit | Physical                 
--------+-----+--------+-------+--------------------------
0:0     | 0   | 0      | 50    | 100                      
0:49    | 0   | 49     | 50    | 149                      
0:50    | 0   | 50     | 50    | TRAP: offset beyond limit
1:0     | 1   | 0      | -     | TRAP: no such segment    

Rule: valid if offset < limit; physical = base + offset
@@END
@@CASE seg: badaddr
mod=seg
opt Addresses=1-2
--TEXT
0 100 50
--ERR
Address '1-2' must look like seg:offset
@@END
@@CASE seg: zero
mod=seg
opt Addresses=0:0
--TEXT
0 100 0
--ERR
Segment 0: limit must be at least 1
@@END
@@CASE frag: small First Fit

opt Strategy=First Fit
--TEXT
100 500 200 300 600
212 417 112 426
--OK

--------+------+----------+---------------+--------------
P1      | 212  | B2 (500) | allocated     | 288          
P2      | 417  | B5 (600) | allocated     | 183          
P3      | 112  | B3 (200) | allocated     | 88           
P4      | 426  | -        | NOT ALLOCATED | -            

Total internal fragmentation: 559
Free (unused) blocks: B1(100), B4(300)
Total free memory: 400
No external fragmentation problem detected.
@@END

@@CASE mp: small
mod=mp
opt Total memory=100
opt Quantum=3
--TEXT
J1 40 8 0
J2 30 5 1
J3 50 6 2
J4 20 4 3
--OK
t=0    ADMIT  J1  memory in use 40/100
t=0    RUN    J1  for 3  (degree of multiprogramming 1)
t=3    ADMIT  J2  memory in use 70/100
t=3    ADMIT  J4  memory in use 90/100
t=3    RUN    J1  for 3  (degree of multiprogramming 3)
t=6    RUN    J2  for 3  (degree of multiprogramming 3)
t=9    RUN    J4  for 3  (degree of multiprogramming 3)
t=12   RUN    J1  for 2  (degree of multiprogramming 3)
t=14   FINISH J1  memory in use 50/100
t=14   ADMIT  J3  memory in use 100/100
t=14   RUN    J2  for 2  (degree of multiprogramming 3)
t=16   FINISH J2  memory in use 70/100
t=16   RUN    J4  for 1  (degree of multiprogramming 2)
t=17   FINISH J4  memory in use 50/100
t=17   RUN    J3  for 3  (degree of multiprogramming 1)
t=20   RUN    J3  for 3  (degree of multiprogramming 1)
t=23   FINISH J3  memory in use 0/100

Total time: 23
CPU utilization: 100.0%
Average memory utilization: 73.0%
Maximum programs in memory at once: 3
@@END
@@CASE mp: edge

opt Quantum=3
--TEXT
J1 100 3 0
J2 100 3 0
--OK

t=0    RUN    J1  for 3  (degree of multiprogramming 1)
t=3    FINISH J1  memory in use 0/100
t=3    ADMIT  J2  memory in use 100/100
t=3    RUN    J2  for 3  (degree of multiprogramming 1)

@@END

opt Quantum=2

J2 20 3 50
--OK

t=0    RUN    J1  for 2  (degree of multiprogramming 1)
t=2    RUN    J1  for 1  (degree of multiprogramming 1)
t=3    FINISH J1  memory in use 0/100
t=50   ADMIT  J2  memory in use 20/100
t=50   RUN    J2  for 2  (degree of multiprogramming 1)
t=52   RUN    J2  for 1  (degree of multiprogramming 1)
t=53   FINISH J2  memory in use 0/100

Total time: 53
CPU utilization: 11.3%
Average memory utilization: 2.3%
Maximum programs in memory at once: 1
@@END
